BfgsVerification.DEmbedding.seed_descent.source_excerpt:
theorem seed_descent_ray {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    SeedOrbit.objective seedC seedD (t • descentDirection)= -t := by
  have hb := root_tight_box
  have hg : -seedC+16*seedD < -1 := by
    dsimp [seedC, seedD]
    linarith [hb.1.1, hb.2.2]
  apply le_antisymm
  · unfold SeedOrbit.objective MaxAffine.Family.objective
    apply Finset.sup'_le
    intro i _
    change dot (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD i) (t • descentDirection)+0 ≤ -t
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [SeedOrbit.gradient, descentDirection, dot, g0, g1, g2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    · ring_nf
      exact le_refl _
    · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg.le ht]
  · have he := (family seedC seedD).branch_le 0 (t • descentDirection)
    simpa [MaxAffine.Family.branch, family, SeedOrbit.gradient, descentDirection, dot, g0, Fin.sum_univ_two] using he

theorem local_cone (n : ℕ) {h : Vec 2}
    (hh : ∀ i : Fin 3, |dot (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD i) h| ≤ scale n/2) :
    objective (center n+h)=(scale n)^3+(scale n)^2*SeedOrbit.objective seedC seedD h := by
  have hle (i : Fin 3) : dot (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD i) h ≤ SeedOrbit.objective seedC seedD h := by
    simpa [MaxAffine.Family.branch, family] using (family seedC seedD).branch_le i h
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply objective_le
    intro i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · exact (last_branch_negative n hh).le.trans ((branch_plateau_positive n 0 (hh 0)).le.trans (by
        rw [branch_plateau n 0 (hh 0)]
        exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hle 0) (sq_nonneg _)) _))
    · rw [branch_plateau n j (hh j)]
      exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hle j) (sq_nonneg _)) _
  · have hmax : SeedOrbit.objective seedC seedD h ≤
        (objective (center n+h)-(scale n)^3)/(scale n)^2 := by
      unfold SeedOrbit.objective MaxAffine.Family.objective
      apply Finset.sup'_le
      intro i _
      change dot (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD i) h+0 ≤ _
      rw [add_zero, le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos (scale_pos n))]
      have hi := branch_le i.castSucc (center n+h)
      rw [branch_plateau n i (hh i)] at hi
      nlinarith
    have hh' := (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos (scale_pos n))).mp hmax
    nlinarith

/-- The actual fixed objective, source centers, full matrices, and deterministic
oracle produce bad starts arbitrarily close to the unique minimizer. All
convergence conclusions are derived from the displayed concrete trajectory. -/
theorem deterministic_embedding_failure :
    Tendsto (fun n => SeedEmbedding.point (center n) ((scale n)^2) 0) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => objective (SeedEmbedding.point (center n) ((scale n)^2) 0)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
    (∀ n, center n≠0 ∧ objective (center n)=(scale n)^3 ∧ 0<objective (center n) ∧
      (0 : Vec 2) ∉ ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential objective (center n) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (objective (center n+t • descentDirection)-objective (center n))/t)
        (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (-((scale n)^2)))) ∧
    (∀ V ∈ 𝓝 (0 : Vec 2), ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      (∀ k, SeedEmbedding.point (center n) ((scale n)^2) k ∈ V) ∧
      ∀ k q, trialPhase q=phase k → center n+(scale n)^2 • SeedEmbedding.trialPoint k q ∈ V) ∧
    (∀ (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (hc₁ : 0<c₁) (hc₁' : c₁≤1/3) (hc : c₁<c₂) (hc₂ : c₂<1)
        (n : ℕ) (hn : 1≤n),
      let R := run hn c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂
      R.H 0=1 ∧ (∀ k, (R.H k).PosDef) ∧
      Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 (center n)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => objective (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 (objective (center n))) ∧
      (∀ k, objective (center n)<objective (R.x k)) ∧
      (∀ k, objective (R.x (k+1))<objective (R.x k)) ∧
      (∀ k, fromMetric objective (R.x k) (R.H k) c₁ c₂ 5=
        (some (R.α k),trialHistory (phase k))) ∧
      (∀ k, (trialHistory (phase k)).length≤5) ∧
      (∀ k q, trialPhase q=phase k →
        HasFDerivAt objective (gradientFunctional ((scale n)^2 • SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD (trialActive q)))
          (R.x k+trialLength q • bfgsStep (R.H k) (R.g k) 1)) ∧
      (∀ m j, R.x (3*m+j.val)=center n+(scale n)^2 • (seedRatio^m • SeedOrbit.point seedC seedD seedRatio j) ∧
        R.H (3*m+j.val)=seedRatio^m • metric seedC seedD j ∧
        R.g (3*m+j.val)=(scale n)^2 • SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD j ∧
        R.α (3*m+j.val)=length j)) := by
  refine ⟨initial_points_tendsto, initial_values_tendsto, ?_,
    fun V hV => trajectories_uniformly_small hV, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    exact ⟨center_ne_zero n, center_value n, center_positive n,
      center_nonstationary n, center_directional_derivative n⟩
  · intro c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂ n hn
    exact ⟨run_initial_matrix hn hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂,
      (run hn c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂).positive_definite,
      run_point_tendsto hn hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂, run_value_tendsto hn hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂,
      run_value_above_center hn hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂, run_value_strict_decrease hn hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂,
      run_search hn hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂, fun k => trialHistory_length_le (phase k),
      run_all_trials_differentiable hn hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂, run_phase_parameters hn hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂⟩

theorem objective_directional_derivative_zero (h : Vec 2) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (objective (t • h)-objective 0)/t)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (max 0 (h 1))) := by
  have hold (i : Fin 3) : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => branch i.castSucc (t • h)/t) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hh := (branch_ray_hasDerivAt_zero i.castSucc h).tendsto_slope_zero_right
    simpa only [branchGradient_zero,dot,Pi.zero_apply,zero_mul,mul_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero,
      zero_add,zero_smul,branch_zero,sub_zero,smul_eq_mul,div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm] using hh
  have hlast : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => branch 3 (t • h)/t) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (h 1)) := by
    have hh := (branch_ray_hasDerivAt_zero 3 h).tendsto_slope_zero_right
    have he : branchGradient 3 (0 : Vec 2)=![0,1] := by
      change mu • (0 : Vec 2)+![0,1]=![0,1]
      simp
    simpa only [he,dot,Fin.sum_univ_two,Matrix.cons_val_zero,Matrix.cons_val_one,
      zero_mul,one_mul,zero_add,zero_smul,branch_zero,sub_zero,smul_eq_mul,div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm] using hh
  have hm := ((hold 0).max (hold 1)).max ((hold 2).max hlast)
  simp only [max_self] at hm
  rw [max_eq_right (le_max_left (0 : ℝ) (h 1))] at hm
  apply hm.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
  rw [objective_zero,sub_zero,objective_nested_max]
  change max (max (branch 0 (t • h)/t) (branch 1 (t • h)/t))
    (max (branch 2 (t • h)/t) (branch 3 (t • h)/t))=_
  rw [max_div_div_right ht.le,max_div_div_right ht.le,max_div_div_right ht.le]

/-- The literal finite-polyhedral-partition hypothesis, with actual affine
inequality cells and separate smooth extension neighborhoods, implies the
source's local full-BFGS convergence conclusion. Full dimensionality and
disjoint cell interiors are unnecessary for this stronger radial proof. -/
theorem finite_polyhedral_basin {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {m : ι → ℕ}
    {F : Vec n → ℝ} (hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F)
    (a : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → Vec n) (b : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → ℝ)
    (V : ι → Set (Vec n)) (f : ι → Vec n → ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i))
    (hsmooth : ∀ i, CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On (V i) (f i))
    {U : Set (Vec n)} (hU : IsOpen U) {star : Vec n} (hsU : star ∈ U)
    (hpart : ∀ i, U ∩ polyhedron (a i) (b i) ⊆ V i)
    (hcover : ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ i, x ∈ polyhedron (a i) (b i))
    (hrep : ∀ i x, x ∈ U → x ∈ polyhedron (a i) (b i) → F x = f i x)
    (hmin : ∀ x, F star ≤ F x) (hu : ∀ x, F x = F star → x = star) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F, F (R.x 0) ≤ F star+δ →
      (∀ k, R.x k ∈ U) ∧ Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 (F star)) ∧
      Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 star) :=
  local_cells_basin hF (fun i => polyhedron (a i) (b i)) V f
    (fun i => polyhedron_closed (a i) (b i)) (fun i => polyhedron_convex (a i) (b i))
    hV hsmooth hU hsU hpart hcover hrep hmin hu

theorem finite_max_local_basin {F : Vec 2 → ℝ} (hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F)
    (star : Vec 2) (hmin : ∀ x, F star≤F x) (hunique : ∀ x, F x=F star → x=star)
    {m : ℕ} {f : Fin m → Vec 2 → ℝ} {U : Set (Vec 2)}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hstar : star∈U) (hf : ∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ U (f i) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (f i) U)
    (hrep : LocalFiniteMax F f star)
    (hind : AffineIndependent ℝ (fun i => coordinateGradient (f (activeIndexMap F f star i)) star))
    (w : Vec (activeIndices F f star).card) (hw : ∀ i, 0<w i)
    (hsum : ∑ i, w i=1)
    (hzero : ∑ i, w i • coordinateGradient (f (activeIndexMap F f star i)) star=0)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : F star<b)
    (hstrict : ∀ ℓ : ℝ, F star<ℓ → ℓ≤b →
      ∀ x y : Vec 2, segment ℝ x y⊆frontier {z | F z≤ℓ} → x=y) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0<ε ∧ ∀ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 F, F (R.x 0)<F star+ε →
      Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 (F star)) ∧ Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 star) := by
  let a := activeIndexMap F f star
  let g : Vec 2 → Fin (activeIndices F f star).card → Vec 2 :=
    fun p i => coordinateGradient (f (a i)) p
  have hd (p : Vec 2) (hp : p∈U) (i : Fin m) :
      HasFDerivAt (f i) (gradientFunctional (coordinateGradient (f i) p)) p :=
    hasFDerivAt_coordinateGradient (((hf i).2.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)).differentiableAt (by norm_num))
  have hr := localFiniteMax_restrict_active (convex_continuous hF).continuousAt
    (fun i => (hd star hstar i).continuousAt) hrep
  have hg : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 star, ∀ i, HasFDerivAt (f (a i)) (gradientFunctional (g p i)) p := by
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hstar] with p hp i
    exact hd p hp (a i)
  have hc (i) : ContinuousAt (fun p => g p i) star :=
    (PlanarCrossing.contDiffAt_coordinateGradient ((hf (a i)).2.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hstar))).continuousAt
  have hbary := local_affine_critical_correctness hF g star hr hg hc hind w hw hsum hzero
  have he : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 star,
      (¬IsAffineCritical F p → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F p ∨ ConvexTwoBranchRegularAt F p) ∧ AffineCorrectAt F p := by
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hstar,hr.eventually,hbary] with p hp hrp hbp
    constructor
    · intro hn
      exact regular_of_finite_max_independent hF hU hp (fun i => hf (a i)) hrp hbp.1 hn
    · intro hcrit
      apply zero_mem_iff_global_minimum.mpr
      exact hbp.2.1.mp ((isAffineCritical_iff_coordinate_affineSpan F p).mp hcrit)
  obtain ⟨r,hrpos,hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp he
  exact PlanarConvergence.local_convergence_basin hF star hmin hunique isOpen_ball
    (mem_ball_self hrpos) (fun p hp => (hball hp).1) (fun p hp => (hball hp).2) hb hstrict

Were a finite local polyhedral C11 partition available, its established local-basin theorem would contradict these actual admissible bad runs on sufficiently low sublevels. No assertion is made that accumulating singularities generally force failure.

Whitening sends them by A transpose, with invertible A. Repeated indexed zeros violate affine independence by its injectivity consequence. A positive weighted combination reduces to lambda_3 e2, or lambda_3 A^T e2, and is nonzero. These are elementary consequences, not a newly compiled standalone endpoint.
